# Modular Carpet by Premrest

> Commercial-grade modular carpet tiles for hotels, motels, considered homes, and investment properties across Australia. Solution-dyed nylon, 15-year wear warranty, ashlar-laid in any room you specify. Available as supply-only direct from the warehouse, or as a full supply-and-install service in Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane.

The product is solution-dyed nylon carpet tile (500 x 1000 mm) with bonded recycled PET felt backing, installed in an ashlar (brick-bond) pattern using pressure-sensitive adhesive. The 15-year manufacturer wear warranty is rated for commercial corridor traffic. Individual tiles can be lifted and replaced, so a damaged section is repaired in minutes rather than re-carpeting the whole room. The same product specified for hotel guest rooms is the product that ships into Australian homes, rentals, and motels.

Distributed in Australia by Premrest (Premier Restorations Group Pty Ltd, Thomastown VIC). Two purchase paths: supply-only ships nationwide direct from the warehouse, or supply-and-install operates as a service in Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane at an indicative ~$20-25/m² installation rate with site-specific costs (preparation, levelling, transitions, removal of existing flooring) itemised separately in the quote.
